label: EMAIL TIP
headline: Use Your Subscriber's Name
body: Adding a subscriber's first name to your email can make your message feel more direct and personal.
caption:
It's a small detail, but using someone's name in your emails can really make them feel seen. It helps your message stand out in a busy inbox and builds a warmer connection. Just make sure you have their name correctly! Most email tools make this easy to set up with personalization tags. Give it a try in your next email.
